{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crossroutes Business Habitat''' was a green 800-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall office building on [[Almania]]'s moon [[Drewwa]] with yellow-white structures ringing every fifth floor starting from six. [[Tendrando Arms]] rented floors 212 to 215, and [[Lyster Innovations]] floors 216 to 218. The [[Amulet of Kalara]] was displayed on the 215th floor.
